Name: Iridium Reskin Pack
Author: LordNeonSlime
Description:
This Pack provides currently 9 different reskins for the Iridium Tools, Scythe, Pan, Nodes, Ores, Trashcan and Sprinklers.
Many of these reskins are inspired by the fact that the Iridium items are differently colored, like the bar, ore and the Axe, so i made textures for all their colorings, and some extra, so it can be applied whats prefered the most.

You can either turn on the entire set, or choose each option individually

I may add more options for reskins over time.

Incompatibilies may appear, when used together with other mods that reskin those sprites. But theres is a option to apply none. Which turns the mods reskins off.
